observedResult.responsiveEnvironment: Chromium DevTools Responsive mode, 400x913 CSS pixels; not a physical phone
observedResult.limitations: This is a local demo. Submission does not send data, create a reservation, or deliver an email. Reload returns an empty form. This clip does not establish production hosting, backend persistence, or physical-device acceptance.

privacyReview.method: 32 one-second output samples; 22 full-resolution output frames covering all eight interval boundaries and all seven detected scene changes; 18 full-resolution source keyframes; nine 20-fps source contact sheets around paste/reload boundaries; decoded all-frame scene-change scan and a terminal-region dark-pixel heuristic on all 640 output frames.
observations: No standalone terminal, credentials, private paths, or unrelated account details observed in the selected output.
Visible form data uses Demo Visitor / demo@example.com and Phone Demo / phone@example.com. The brief autofill suggestions contain only these demo values.
Responsive footage retains the actual DevTools panel and 400x913 dimensions. The panel displays the generated site's HTML/CSS.
Both desktop and responsive clipboard insertion occur after the terminal has disappeared.
No cursor is embedded in the reviewed footage; no cursor was added during editing.
privacyReview.limitations: Visual sampling, boundary-frame review, and automated motion/terminal checks are not OCR or an exhaustive frame-by-frame credential audit. The complete 577.9-second raw source remains private and is not approved for publication.
privacyReview.publicScope: Only this 32-second output asset and its sanitized manifest are reviewed for public use.
